rationales: Emil Fischer studied sugars and proteins, but did not first propose the concept of metabolism.
Ibn-e-Nafis is credited in the textbook context with first presenting the concept of metabolism.
Jabir Bin Hayyan is known for contributions to chemistry, not for first proposing metabolism.
Wilhelm Kühne coined the term enzyme, rather than first proposing metabolism.
Pasteur is known for work on microorganisms and vaccination, not discovering meiosis.
Golgi is associated with the Golgi apparatus, not discovering meiosis.
Walther Flemming is credited with discovering meiosis.
Oscar Hertwig studied fertilization, but is not the credited discoverer of meiosis here.
Regeneration is the replacement or regrowth of lost or damaged parts, not tumor formation.
Crossing over is the exchange of genetic material between homologous chromosomes.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells that can form new tumors.
Synapsis is the pairing of homologous chromosomes during meiosis.
The nucleolus is where ribosomal subunits are assembled.
Plastids do not construct the cell’s ribosomes.
The endoplasmic reticulum may have ribosomes attached, but ribosomes are assembled in the nucleolus.
The cell wall does not construct ribosomes.
Family is a taxonomic rank above genus and species.
Species is the basic unit of biological classification.
Class is a higher taxonomic rank, not the basic unit.
Genus contains one or more related species and is not the basic unit.
Deduction follows from a hypothesis and is not the first step.
A hypothesis is proposed after observations identify a problem.
Experiments test a hypothesis and occur later in the investigation.
Observations are the first step in solving a biological problem.
A tissue is a group of similar cells performing the same function.
An organelle is a specialized structure within a cell, not a group of cells.
An organ consists of different tissues working together.
An organ system consists of organs working together.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1976.
Meiosis was discovered in 1876.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1786.
Meiosis was not discovered in 1796.
Chromosomes are duplicated during the S phase of interphase.
The G₁ phase involves cell growth, not chromosome duplication.
This is another listing of G₁, which is not when chromosomes are duplicated.
The G₀ phase is a resting state in which cells are not preparing to divide.
Cisternae are flattened membrane sacs, especially in the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus.
Stroma is the fluid-filled interior of a chloroplast.
Grana are stacks of thylakoids in chloroplasts.
Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
Protista includes eukaryotic organisms, not prokaryotes.
Monera includes prokaryotic organisms in the traditional five-kingdom classification.
Fungi are eukaryotic organisms.
Plantae are eukaryotic organisms.
Zoology is the study of animals.
Microbiology is the study of microorganisms.
Botany is the study of plants.
Morphology studies form and structure and is not specifically the division for plant study.
Monocytes do not cause blood clotting; platelets are chiefly responsible.
Neutrophils are white blood cells involved mainly in defense against infection.
Lymphocytes are involved in immune responses, not blood clotting.
Basophils release substances such as heparin and are not responsible for forming blood clots.
Arteries generally do not have valves along their length to prevent backflow.
Veins contain valves that help prevent blood from flowing backward.
Capillaries do not contain valves.
Not all three vessel types contain valves to prevent backflow.
One gram of protein provides about 4 kilocalories of energy.
One gram of protein does not provide 9 kilocalories; that is the approximate value for fat.
One gram of protein provides far less than 70 kilocalories.
One gram of protein provides far less than 100 kilocalories.
